description: This Java class provides URL transformation utilities for SEO-friendly URLs in an Apache OFBiz based e-commerce application. It implements a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to generate category and product URLs, handle URL forwarding, and manage URL mappings and configurations related to product categories and product entities.

classes.name: CatalogUrlSeoTransform
classes.description: Provides URL transformation functions for categories and products, including SEO-friendly URL generation, URL forwarding and mapping management in an OFBiz-based web application.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the provided map, handling different object types (SimpleScalar, GenericObjectModel).

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a Writer wrapper that captures output and performs URL generation logic during closure, integrating with FreeMarker environment.

methods.name: isCategoryMapInitialed
methods.description: Checks whether category URL mappings have been initialized.

methods.name: getCategoryNameIdMap
methods.description: Returns the map of category names (or URL-safe strings) to category IDs.

methods.name: getCategoryIdNameMap
methods.description: Returns the map of category IDs to category names (or URL-safe strings).

methods.name: initCategoryMap
methods.description: Initializes category name/id mappings from the database, respecting URL configuration rules.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Constructs a product URL based on request context, category, and product details, applying URL rules and SEO naming.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Creates a category URL including optional view parameters and search string, respecting URL configuration.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Generates a product URL for use in services, considering parameters like trail, category, and product info.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Builds a category URL for services with optional view parameters and search term.

methods.name: getNiceName
methods.description: Converts a string to a URL-friendly, lowercased, hyphenated format, validating against ASCII pattern.

methods.name: forwardProductUri
methods.description: Handles forwarding for product URIs based on URL patterns.

methods.name: forwardUri
methods.description: Performs URI forwarding for categories and products based on URL patterns and mappings.

methods.name: forwardCategoryUri
methods.description: Handles forwarding for category URLs based on URL patterns and mappings.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Constructs product URL during service calls, considering category trail and URL configurations.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Constructs category URL during service calls with optional view and search parameters.
